mapper.sql: SELECT gd.group_deal_id, gd.product_id, gd.title, gd.sub_title, gd.group_deal_detail, gd.origin_price, gd.deal_price, gd.discount_rate, gd.min_member_count, gd.max_member_count, gd.current_quantity, gd.per_user_limit_qty, gd.status, gd.start_at, gd.end_at, gd.shipping_start_date, gd.shipping_end_date FROM GROUP_DEAL gd WHERE gd.group_deal_id = #{groupDealId} AND gd.is_active = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT image_id, group_deal_id, image_url, sort_order FROM GROUP_DEAL_IMAGE WHERE group_deal_id = #{groupDealId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT m.member_id AS participantId, m.user_id AS memberId, NULL AS memberName, NULL AS phone, m.quantity AS quantity, m.status AS status, m.joined_at AS createdAt FROM GROUP_DEAL_MEMBER m WHERE m.group_deal_id = #{groupDealId} ORDER BY m.joined_at DESC
mapper.insert:
SELECT GROUP_DEAL_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO GROUP_DEAL ( group_deal_id, product_id, title, sub_title, group_deal_detail, origin_price, deal_price, discount_rate, min_member_count, max_member_count, per_user_limit_qty, start_at, end_at, status, is_active, created_by, created_date, updated_date, shipping_start_date, shipping_end_date, current_quantity ) VALUES ( #{groupDealId}, #{productId}, #{title}, #{subTitle}, #{detail}, #{originPrice}, #{dealPrice}, #{discountRate}, #{minMemberCount}, #{maxMemberCount}, #{perUserLimitQty}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, 'OPEN', 'Y', #{createdBy}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{shippingStartDate}, #{shippingEndDate}, 0 )
INSERT INTO GROUP_DEAL_IMAGE ( image_id, group_deal_id, image_url, sort_order, created_date ) VALUES ( GROUP_DEAL_IMAGE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{groupDealId}, #{imageUrl}, #{sortOrder}, SYSDATE )
INSERT INTO GROUP_DEAL_MEMBER ( member_id, group_deal_id, user_id, quantity, status, joined_at ) VALUES ( GROUP_DEAL_MEMBER_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{groupDealId}, #{userId}, #{quantity}, 'REQUESTED', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT gd.group_deal_id, gd.title, gd.sub_title, gd.origin_price, gd.deal_price, gd.discount_rate, gd.current_quantity, gd.min_member_count, gd.status, gd.end_at, gi.image_url AS thumbnail_image_url FROM GROUP_DEAL gd LEFT JOIN GROUP_DEAL_IMAGE gi ON gd.group_deal_id = gi.group_deal_id AND gi.sort_order = 1 WHERE gd.is_active = 'Y' AND gd.created_by = #{createdBy} ORDER BY gd.created_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE GROUP_DEAL SET product_id = #{productId}, title = #{title}, sub_title = #{subTitle}, group_deal_detail = #{detail}, origin_price = #{originPrice}, deal_price = #{dealPrice}, discount_rate = #{discountRate}, min_member_count = #{minMemberCount}, max_member_count = #{maxMemberCount}, per_user_limit_qty = #{perUserLimitQty}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt}, shipping_start_date = #{shippingStartDate}, shipping_end_date = #{shippingEndDate}, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE group_deal_id = #{groupDealId} AND created_by = #{createdBy} AND is_active = 'Y'
UPDATE GROUP_DEAL SET status = #{status}, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE group_deal_id = #{groupDealId} AND is_active = 'Y'
UPDATE GROUP_DEAL SET is_active = 'N', updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE group_deal_id = #{groupDealId}
